text:
marta: Quick heads up — there's a hotpatch PR up for the auth token regression. Need 2x LGTM before the 18:00 PT cutoff or we'll have to delay the rollout to tomorrow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/5889 :exclamation:

alex: On it, running full unit + smoke now. If smoke is clean I can approve.

sam: Skimming diff, looks straightforward. One comment about a log line but not blocking. :eyes:

riyad: I can do a security quick-check in ~10m. Please add a tiny blurb in the PR description about revert steps.

marta: Thanks. Revert steps added to the PR description. Also tagging QA for a quick sanity pass.

karen: I can take a quick manual run through the auth flow in staging — give me the deploy link?

alex: smoke passed locally. Posting short runbook used: ```./tools/smoke_test.sh --env=staging --suite=auth```

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved at 2026-03-17T18:10:00Z for PR #5889 (can be bumped by owners).

sam: Left a non-blocking nit about a function name. Approving because it's low risk. :thumbsup:

riyad: Security quick-check done — no secrets logged, token lifecycle unchanged. Approving.

marta: That makes 2x LGTM. I'm going to merge once Karen confirms staging sanity so we don't surprise prod.

karen: Staging flow looks good. No regressions in basic login or refresh tokens.

marta: Merging now. Will monitor the deploy dashboard and rollback if anything odd within the first 15m. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
